youtube_description:
Here’s a quick video on “how to use a crow’s foot adapter” to properly torque a nut. In our example, we are torquing the chain adjuster locknut found on a Yamaha R6. I’m teaching these students not to adhere to “good enough” and to make it a practice of following the service manual procedures. 
Some would say this is not needed and over-kill. My style of instruction is to incorporate “muscle memory” into service manual usage and buying into the confidence of doing it correctly. 

Keep Wrenching, 
Shane Conley
Instructor/Motivator/Motorcyclist


Thank you for watching. Please subscribe and share my work!
